description: BRC.4 -- the mainframe Command Environment, HOUSED IN ff-idcams (command-environments Req 16.1/16.4). A MainframeEnvironment implementing ff_vfs::BackendEnvironment: name()->"MAINFRAME", record_capable()->true, is_case_sensitive()->false, byte save()->error (record-only resource), and save_records(target, records, attrs) that stores over an owned Arc<dyn ff_dscatalog::DatasetAccess> via resolve/allocate -> open(Write) -> put each record -> close (the RECFM codec frames bytes on close, Req 18.7), mapping DatasetError to RecordStoreOutcome::Stored{rc} with x37/space-full -> non-zero rc (Req 18.8). Self-contained in ff-idcams and fully unit-testable against a real CatalogDatasetAccess on a TempDir -- no ff-desktop dependency. This is the record-capable backend FEAT-002 wires in.
steps: Add `ff-vfs = { path = "../ff-vfs" }` to crates/ff-idcams/Cargo.toml [dependencies] (new acyclic edge ff-idcams -> ff-vfs; ff-idcams already depends on ff-dscatalog).

Create crates/ff-idcams/src/mainframe_env.rs with `pub struct MainframeEnvironment { access: std::sync::Arc<dyn ff_dscatalog::DatasetAccess> }` and `pub fn new(access: std::sync::Arc<dyn ff_dscatalog::DatasetAccess>) -> Self`.

impl ff_vfs::BackendEnvironment for MainframeEnvironment: name()->"MAINFRAME"; is_case_sensitive()->false; record_capable()->true; save(path,bytes) returns Err(std::io::Error::other("MAINFRAME is record-only; use save_records")) with a doc comment explaining a mainframe dataset has no host-path byte save.

Implement save_records(target, records, attrs): map attrs.recfm (ff_vfs::RecordFormatKind Fixed/Variable/Undefined) + attrs.lrecl to ff_dscatalog::Recfm (Fixed->FB, Variable->VB, Undefined->U) via a private helper; resolve the dataset by target.dsn with access.resolve(dsn, AccessIntent::Write); on DatasetError::NotFound prefer a non-zero rc (document) OR allocate a PS dataset if attrs carry enough identity -- default to resolve-only and document the choice; then access.open(&handle, AccessIntent::Write), pull every records.next_record() and access.put(&mut open, &ff_dscatalog::Record { key: vec![], data: rec.to_vec() }), then access.close(open).

Map the outcome to ff_vfs::RecordStoreOutcome (Req 18.8): Ok -> Stored{rc:0}; DatasetError::SpaceAbend -> Stored{rc:37}; DatasetError::VolumeFull -> Stored{rc:37}; DatasetError::ReadOnlyVolume -> Stored{rc:8}; other Err -> Stored{rc:12}. Document the rc table in a doc comment. Never return NotRecordCapable.
Keep mainframe_env.rs under 400 non-test lines; if the test module exceeds ~200 lines put it in crates/ff-idcams/src/mainframe_env_tests.rs with `#[path = "mainframe_env_tests.rs"] mod tests;`.
crates/ff-idcams/src/lib.rs: add `pub mod mainframe_env;` and `pub use mainframe_env::MainframeEnvironment;`.

WRITE TESTS FIRST (red before green): model the DatasetAccess fixture on crates/ff-dscatalog/src/dataset_access/impl_access_tests.rs (native StorageProvider over a TempDir + a VolumeRegistry + allocate a PS FB dataset). (T1a) mainframe_env_stores_records_via_dataset_access_round_trip -- drive save_records with N records, then open+get the dataset back through the same access and assert the records round-trip through the RECFM codec (boundaries are the codec's, not CRLF). (T1b) mainframe_env_maps_space_abend_to_nonzero_rc -- size the volume to force SpaceAbend/VolumeFull (mirror put_growth_surfaces_x37_space_abend) and assert Stored{rc} with rc != 0. (T1c) mainframe_env_is_record_capable_and_object_safe -- record_capable() is true and the CE is usable as Box<dyn ff_vfs::BackendEnvironment>. Each test carries // Validates: command-environments Requirement 18.7 / 18.8 / 18.3-18.4.
acceptance_criteria: cargo test -p ff-idcams passes, including the three new tests (record round-trip through DatasetAccess open->put->close; x37/space-full -> non-zero rc; record_capable + object-safe).
The round-trip test proves save_records persists records through CatalogDatasetAccess such that a subsequent open+get returns the same records framed by the RECFM codec (not host text lines).
The space test proves a DatasetError::SpaceAbend/VolumeFull surfaces as RecordStoreOutcome::Stored with a non-zero (x37-class) rc, never a panic and never NotRecordCapable.
MainframeEnvironment is usable as Box<dyn ff_vfs::BackendEnvironment> (object-safe) and reports record_capable()==true, name()=="MAINFRAME".
ff-idcams depends on ff-vfs via Cargo (acyclic); ff-vfs/ff-volume/ff-dscatalog gain NO dependency on ff-idcams.
mainframe_env.rs is ASCII-only and under 400 non-test lines; cargo clippy -p ff-idcams is clean with -D warnings; cargo fmt applied.
findings:
FEAT-001 COMPLETE (uncommitted on main). Facts FEAT-002 needs to wire the backend:

1. CONSTRUCTOR SIGNATURE: `ff_idcams::MainframeEnvironment::new(access: std::sync::Arc<dyn ff_dscatalog::DatasetAccess>) -> MainframeEnvironment`. The CE OWNS the Arc<dyn DatasetAccess>; build it in ff-desktop from `ff_dscatalog::CatalogDatasetAccess::new(provider: Arc<dyn ff_vfs::StorageProvider>, registry: ff_volume::VolumeRegistry)` and wrap: `Arc::new(CatalogDatasetAccess::new(...)) as Arc<dyn ff_dscatalog::DatasetAccess>`.

2. MODULE PATH / RE-EXPORT: `pub mod mainframe_env;` added to crates/ff-idcams/src/lib.rs; re-exported as `pub use mainframe_env::MainframeEnvironment;`. So FEAT-002 can import `ff_idcams::MainframeEnvironment` directly. Hold it as `Box<dyn ff_vfs::BackendEnvironment>` (object-safe, Send+Sync) in the environment registry; register under name "MAINFRAME".

3. BackendEnvironment behaviour FEAT-002 relies on: name()=="MAINFRAME", is_case_sensitive()==false, record_capable()==true. save(path,bytes) RETURNS Err(io::Error::other("MAINFRAME is record-only; use save_records")) -- so the editor SAVE walk MUST take the record path for a MAINFRAME tab (it already selects by Document::record_format() + backend.record_capable(); ensure the mainframe tab's Document has a non-Delimited RecordFormat set at open so save_records fires, else the byte save errors).

4. FINAL rc-MAPPING VALUES (RecordStoreOutcome::Stored{rc}): Ok->0; DatasetError::SpaceAbend->37; DatasetError::VolumeFull->37; DatasetError::ReadOnlyVolume->8; ALL OTHER errors (including NotFound)->12. NEVER returns NotRecordCapable.

5. RESOLVE-ONLY (NOT allocate-on-NotFound): save_records does access.resolve(target.dsn, AccessIntent::Write) -> open(Write) -> put each record {key: vec![], data: rec} -> close (codec frames bytes on close). A NotFound dataset maps to rc=12, it does NOT allocate (RecordAttrs lacks volume/space/geometry identity; allocation stays the open/allocator flow's job). THEREFORE: the ff-desktop open flow MUST have already allocated/resolved the dataset in the catalog BEFORE the first SAVE, and StoreTarget.dsn MUST be the REAL DSN (from store_identity), not a host path -- otherwise resolve returns NotFound -> rc=12 and the save reports an error.

6. DEPS ADDED: crates/ff-idcams/Cargo.toml now has `ff-vfs = { path = "../ff-vfs" }` under [dependencies] (new acyclic edge ff-idcams -> ff-vfs) and dev-deps ff-volume + tempfile. ff-vfs/ff-volume/ff-dscatalog gained NO dep on ff-idcams. FLAG for the owner's full gate: if ff-governance-tests enumerate allowed DAG edges explicitly, the new ff-idcams->ff-vfs edge (and the forthcoming ff-desktop->ff-idcams edge) may need adding.

7. VERIFICATION DONE (scoped): cargo test -p ff-idcams = 37 unit (incl. 3 new) + 22 integration PASS; cargo clippy -p ff-idcams -- -D warnings = EXIT 0 clean; cargo fmt applied; mainframe_env.rs is ASCII-only, 185 lines (~182 non-test); test module split into mainframe_env_tests.rs via #[path].
